_text: [amused] The next morning, the old man who owns those woods finds it, and he HATES litter, so he calls the police. [urgent, building] In the pile: envelopes from the vault, a videotape, and a receipt with your *name* on it. [dramatic, booming] And remember that sandwich? Half-eaten... salami... covered in your crew's DNA. [exasperated] Speedy was right: you do get caught, because of *Speedy*. [dramatic] Five days later, you're in handcuffs. Most of the diamonds are never found. [amused] Ten layers of security, beaten by *hairspray*. [deadpan] And undone by a *sandwich*.
